summary:
The "Florida Freeze Disaster Assistance Act" (S. 4663) provides emergency supplemental appropriations to the Department of Agriculture to mitigate agricultural revenue, quality, and production losses resulting from freeze or cold weather conditions. 

Section 2 of the Act appropriates $3,500,000,000 out of the Treasury for fiscal year ending September 30, 2027, to remain available until expended, under the heading "Agricultural Programs—Office of the Secretary." The operative mechanism directs the Secretary of Agriculture to distribute these funds as block grants to States. Eligible losses encompass revenue, quality, or production losses of crops (including prevented plantings), trees, bushes, and vines resulting from a freeze or cold weather condition. The provision contains a statutory mandate that the assistance include compensation to producers for multi-year crop losses.

The Act establishes several conditions precedent and limitations on the disbursement of these funds. First, availability is restricted exclusively to losses occurring in counties that received a presidential or secretarial disaster designation for freeze and related cold weather conditions issued by the Secretary of Agriculture on March 4, 2026. Second, the Secretary may only make these funds available upon the request of a State department of agriculture or another appropriate State agency, as determined by the Secretary. 

Additionally, Section 2 imposes a recurring reporting requirement. The Secretary must submit a report describing the implementation of the assistance to the House and Senate Committees on Appropriations. The initial report is due not later than 120 days after the date of enactment, with subsequent reports required for each fiscal quarter thereafter until the appropriated funds are fully expended. 

Finally, the $3,500,000,000 appropriation is designated by Congress as an emergency requirement pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(i) of the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985 (2 U.S.C. 901(b)(2)(A)(i)).
